sections.heading: CONTROL Resonant Guide: Start Here
sections.intro: CONTROL Resonant is an action-adventure RPG from Remedy Entertainment in which Dylan Faden leaves the Oldest House for a Manhattan distorted by a paranatural crisis. The official Steam description highlights exploration, gravity anomalies, evolving threats and Dylan's shapeshifting melee weapon, the Aberrant.
paragraphs: This guide hub is organized around the moments where a broad overview is least useful: an active quest objective, a room with a solution hidden in its layout, a collectible route, or a combat system that needs a clear input sequence. Open the guide matching the title in your mission log instead of trying to force unrelated markers into the same route.

The game does not always present activities in one fixed order. Story progress, traversal powers and open zones determine which doors, roofs and gravity paths are practical. That makes a short answer valuable, but it also makes the condition around that answer important. Each linked page starts with the quickest route before explaining the surrounding objective.
bullets: Use quest walkthroughs when an objective marker stops making sense.
Use puzzle guides for a direct solution and a check of the room state.
Use collectible guides when you want a route that matches the zones you can currently reach.

sections.heading: Quest Walkthroughs
sections.intro: Side Stories are more than optional map pins: they commonly send Dylan through several rooms, zones or mechanics. The walkthroughs below keep the next actionable task visible while preserving the details that prevent a dead end.

subsections.heading: Unsupervised Science
paragraphs: Unsupervised Science is the right page when a testing-facility marker is hovering over a surface location but the laboratory entrance is underground. Its route separates the six facilities and the two puzzle families—soda-dispenser state changes and timed power transfers—so a solution for one room is not mistaken for a solution for every room.

subsections.heading: Crossing the Threshold
paragraphs: Crossing the Threshold follows evidence through Central's Field Hospital, Loading Docks, Dig Site and Security Station before leading to Wilson. The walkthrough is structured as an investigation, then a return route, rather than a plot recap.

subsections.heading: Panopticon Service Request
paragraphs: Panopticon Service Request begins as maintenance at Langston's Central field panopticon and becomes an Altered Item containment task. The guide keeps its batteries, dish repair, cell identification and radio timing in the order the terminal asks for them.

sections.heading: Puzzle Solutions
sections.intro: Puzzle pages are separate from walkthroughs because they answer a different question: what should be changed in this room right now? They put the result before the explanation, then explain how to check the state if the trigger does not fire.

subsections.heading: Laundromat Puzzle
paragraphs: The Central Wear'Em & Wash'Em laundromat uses a seven-row 0/1 note. Each row maps to washing machines; 1 means on and 0 means off. The solution opens a secret passage after the exterior blockade has been cleared.

subsections.heading: Freeze Frame
paragraphs: Freeze Frame is a route puzzle repeated across the map. Altered cameras freeze Dylan if they see him, so the task is to find a way behind each camera and interact with it from outside its field of view.

sections.heading: Collectibles and Side Content
sections.intro: Collectibles are easier to finish when routes are grouped by what you are carrying and where you can move, not by a long undifferentiated checklist.
paragraphs: The Complete Set is a speaker-and-subwoofer side story centered on an Auction House ritual. It has a known final interaction issue, so the guide includes the official support advice beside the collection route. Dog Toy Locations follows the Mysterious Dog through seven regions, where each return depends on carrying the missing dragon toy back to the bed.

Both activities reward observation of the immediate environment. For the dog route, Chowrap signs are a useful visual clue; for the speaker route, the relevant item and ritual space matter more than clearing every nearby icon first.

sections.heading: Combat Guides
sections.intro: Combat guidance is deliberately limited to a system with a clear, repeatable purpose instead of pretending every encounter has one universal build.
paragraphs: Combo Finishers extend Dylan's normal primary-weapon chain. Once unlocked and equipped, they give the final input a distinct role: focused Falter pressure, room-clearing space or a persistent blade effect. The choice is situational, so the combat page compares use cases rather than declaring a permanent tier list.

The official game description confirms that the Aberrant shifts between forms and that combat combines the environment, elemental abilities and melee weaponry. Use that flexibility: a finisher is strongest when it closes a safe string, not when it forces Dylan to stand inside an incoming attack.

sections.heading: About CONTROL Resonant
sections.intro: CONTROL Resonant is developed and published by Remedy Entertainment. On Steam, it is described as a single-player action, adventure and RPG set in a warped Manhattan after a paranatural catastrophe escapes the Oldest House.
paragraphs: Dylan Faden is the playable lead. Steam describes his path as a search for his sister Jesse while he develops paranatural abilities and fights the Hiss, Mold and other threats. The setting's gravity anomalies are not just scenery: they reshape routes and add tactical decisions to combat.

For purchase details, editions, supported languages and current platform information, use the official Steam page. This site concentrates on playable routes and avoids turning changing storefront data into the center of every guide.

faq.question: What is CONTROL Resonant?
faq.answer: CONTROL Resonant is Remedy Entertainment's action-adventure RPG sequel starring Dylan Faden in a paranaturally altered Manhattan.

faq.question: Where can I find CONTROL Resonant puzzle solutions?
faq.answer: Use the Laundromat Puzzle guide for the Central washing-machine solution and Freeze Frame for altered-camera routes.

faq.question: Does this site include CONTROL Resonant quest walkthroughs?
faq.answer: Yes. Unsupervised Science, Crossing the Threshold and Panopticon Service Request each have their own walkthrough.

faq.answer: The Complete Set and Dog Toy Locations cover the launch collectible and side-content routes.
